Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Zephyr's team was impressed. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of points before we proceed with signature:

- Public announcement: we generally allow reference announcements but we require a 7-business-day embargo from the date we approve the quote and a final signoff from our VP of Marketing on the messaging and quote.

Subject: RE: Reference & announcement window — proposed redlines and timeline

Ben / team — thanks for the context. I've drafted targeted language that tracks Zephyr's bullets while keeping Redwood's need for a predictable go-live/marketing cadence. Key points below; proposed clauses attached as "Proposed_Publicity_Redlines_20281201.docx" (attached).

Summary of proposed changes (high-level):
1) Embargo and approvals: add a publicity clause to the Order Form stating: "Customer grants Redwood permission to make public announcements regarding the existence of the business relationship provided Redwood delivers proposed announcement text to Customer and Customer has seven (7) calendar days to review and approve or reasonably request changes. Approval of non-material copy edits shall not restart such seven (7) calendar day period. Material changes to the announcement requested by Customer will restart the review period."

2) Logo/brand assets: add requirement that "Redwood shall not use Customer's logos or trademarks until Customer has delivered an assets package and written usage guidelines. Customer retains the right to withhold consent for specific uses; no logo alteration allowed."

3) Executive quotes: include a clause that Redwood may request a quote from an identified Customer executive, and Customer shall have forty-eight (48) hours to approve or decline the quote; approval may be withheld in Customer's sole discretion.

4) Reference scope: limit references to "Customer name and industry vertical" for marketing materials absent separate written permission for additional detail; no product performance metrics without express prior written consent.

Operational ask and timeline:
- I'll attach the redline document for the MSA/Order Form. If Zephyr is OK with the language, Sales should confirm with a one-paragraph note and we'll push the DocuSign envelope (link below).
- Proposed internal timeline: 12/01 — legal redlines sent to customer; 12/03 — expected customer signoff if no material changes; 12/04 — DocuSign complete. If Zephyr needs more time for marketing review, let us know and we'll extend the signature window.

DocuSign prep link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/Doc-RED-4421
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/ZE-4421

Attachments: Proposed_Publicity_Redlines_20281201.docx

Let me know if you want any tightened language for the MSA confidentiality carveout vs. publicity clause — I kept the publicity terms as an Order Form addendum to avoid changing the MSA core.

Thanks,
